notices.cancelled: Trip cancelled. It's off the public schedule.
notices.reinstated: Back on! The trip is on the schedule again.
notices.crewConflict: Crew wasn't changed. Someone is already assigned during this time, or the course would fall below its teaching ratio.
notices.bookingRemoved: Booking cancelled. The spot is open again.
notices.bookingRemovedRefunded: Booking cancelled and the payment refunded. The spot is open again.
notices.bookingRemovedForfeit: Booking cancelled. The spot is open again. It was past the cancellation window, so the seat was non-refundable.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundManual: Booking cancelled. A refund is owed but must be issued by hand (counter payment, or Stripe isn't connected). Refund from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundFailed: Booking cancelled, but the automatic refund didn't go through. Issue it from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundReview: Booking cancelled. The payment record and Stripe disagree on what was captured, so review the diver's payments before issuing any refund.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundInProgress: Booking cancelled. A refund for this seat is already going through.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundReconcile: Booking cancelled. An earlier refund reached Stripe but wasn't recorded here. Reconcile it in Stripe before issuing another.
notices.bookingRemovedRefundOwner: Booking cancelled and the seat is open. It was paid, so an owner or manager issues the refund from the diver's payments.
notices.bookingRestoreFull: Couldn't undo. The freed spot has been taken and the trip is full again. Add them to the wait list instead.
notices.bookingRestoreRatio: Couldn't undo. The freed seat is taken and this session is at its instructor ratio. Assign another instructor, or use the wait list.
notices.bookingRestoreCancelled: Couldn't undo. This trip has been cancelled. Reinstate the trip first, then add them back.
notices.diverAddedWaiverUndelivered: Diver added to the trip, but their waiver wasn’t emailed. Send it or share the link from their row below.
notices.diverWaitlisted: Diver added to the wait list.
notices.identityConfirmed: Identity confirmed. This diver can be cleared to board.
notices.certified: Certified. They can book their next level with no further review.
notices.certifiedAwaitingCard: Recorded. It won't clear a gate until someone confirms it against the card.
notices.certifyFailed: That didn't save. Check they're still on this roster and the level is picked, then try again.
notices.contactIncomplete: A contact needs both a name and a phone number before the crew can reach someone.
notices.pickupInvalid: Check the pickup time and lodging details and try again.
notices.diverInvalid: Enter a name and a valid email to add a diver.
notices.diverFull: That trip is full. Add them to the wait list instead.
notices.diverWaitlistAvailable: There's room on this trip. Add them to the trip instead of the wait list.
notices.diverAlready: That diver already has a booking on this trip.
notices.diverCourseUnstaffed: This course session needs an instructor assigned before you can add divers.
notices.diverCoursePrerequisite: That diver doesn't have a verified certification on file for this course's prerequisite.
notices.diverCourseRatioFull: This session is at its instructor-to-student ratio limit. Assign another instructor, or add them to the wait list.
notices.diverCourseMinAge: That diver is under this course's minimum age on the day it runs, going by the date of birth on their profile. Correct the date if it's wrong.
notices.diverTripPrerequisite: That diver's certifications on file don't reach what this trip and its dive sites require. Check the requirements below against their record.
notices.diverUnavailable: This trip can't accept new divers right now.
notices.waiverComplete: That diver already has a completed waiver.

notices.waiverError: That waiver link could not be created. Try a current booking and template.
notices.recapNote: Recap note saved. It rides along on every diver's recap.
notices.arrivalPhotoFailed: The arrival photo could not be saved. Check the image and try again.

notices.conditions: Crew prediction published. Divers will see it now.
notices.conditionsCleared: Crew prediction cleared. Divers will see the automated outlook when it is available.
notices.notAuthorized: Trip setup is limited to owners, managers, and instructors. Ask one of them to make this change.
notices.invalid: That didn't save. Check the date, times, and capacity, then try again.
notices.endBeforeStart: The trip has to end after it starts.

details.heading: Details
details.payAtBookingDescription: Optional. Leave the deposit blank to charge the full fare when a diver books online.
details.depositDescription: Charged now; the balance is still owed at the dock.
details.depositTitle: Only applies when set below the trip price.
details.cancellationWindowDescription: Hours before departure a diver can cancel for a refund.
details.summaryNoPrice: No price set, so the booking page shows no fare
details.arrivalGuidanceDescription: Give divers one clear place to go, what to look for, and the first person to find. Keep it practical and public.
details.arrivalLandmarkDescription: A shop-authored landmark, such as a pier name or visible sign.
details.arrivalParkingDescription: Where to park or what to know about parking.
details.arrivalTransitDescription: A public-transit or ride-share tip, if useful.
details.arrivalLookForDescription: The visible cue that tells a diver they are in the right place.
details.arrivalFirstInteractionDescription: The first human interaction, such as who to ask for at the desk.
details.arrivalPhotoDescription: Optional shop-authored photo or illustration. Do not include private information.
details.minimumBookingsDescription: Leave blank and the boat goes with whoever books. Set it and divers see the number on the booking page. If it hasn't got there by the deadline below, the departure cancels itself and emails everyone aboard.
details.minimumDecisionDescription: How long before departure the call is made. The booking page publishes the exact moment.
